name: Apartlino TV
tagline: Ekran dobrodošlice za goste na televizoru u apartmanu
description: Gost uključi TV i vidi svoje ime, Wi-Fi, kućni red, vremensku prognozu i događaje u gradu, uz pokretanje Netflixa i YouTubea. Imena gostiju se popunjavaju sama iz rezervacijskih mailova. Besplatno za vlasnike.
audience: Iznajmljivači u BiH, Hrvatskoj i Srbiji

en.tagline: A welcome screen for guests on the apartment TV
en.description: Guests turn on the TV and see their name, the Wi-Fi password, house rules, the weather and events in town, plus one-tap Netflix and YouTube. Guest names fill in automatically from booking emails. Free for owners.
en.audience: Hosts in Bosnia, Croatia and Serbia
